title: AppraisalMeasure
description: ITIP data archetype — quantitative governance measure for dashboard indicators. Rootless (no GSM base extension). Types the effect payload emitted by appraisal Mechanisms for every rule evaluation, regardless of whether a threshold was breached. Each measure provides the raw indicator value, its unit, optional component breakdown, and optional entity-level details. Stored by the BFF for trend computation and dashboard rendering. Source: ITIP (domain archetype for governance appraisal).

ruleType.description: Appraisal rule type URI that produced this measure. Matches AppraisalRuleType.type.

subjectType.description: GSM subject type of the measured entity.

subjectDefinitionId.description: Definition ID of the measured entity.

value.description: The indicator value. Semantics depend on unit: 0–100 for percentages/ratios, raw integer for counts, elapsed days for durations.

unit.description: Unit of the value. percent = 0–100 integer percentage. count = absolute integer count. days = elapsed time in days. ratio = 0–100 integer ratio (numerator * 100 // denominator).

components.description: Optional breakdown of the value into constituent parts — e.g. {numerator, denominator} for ratios, {compatible, conflicting, total} for compatibility checks.

details.description: Optional entity-level breakdown — e.g. per-Norm evaluation results, per-Directive conflict pairs, per-property coverage status. Structure varies by rule type.
